title: LBPH Face Representation
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of local binary patterns and trained recognizer, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in face-recognition-attendance-system.
learning_objectives: Explain local binary patterns and trained recognizer in plain language and connect it to AMS_Run.py; training.py; TrainingImageLabel/Trainner.yml.
Trace one input through the lbph face representation stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
concepts_covered: local binary patterns and trained recognizer
practical_outcomes: Trace the lbph face representation stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for local binary patterns and trained recognizer.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
